arxiv-2203-01479.title: Weightless Neural Networks for Efficient Edge Inference
arxiv-2203-01479.creator: Zachary Susskind 1 , Aman Arora 2, Igor Dantas Dos Santos Miranda 3, Luis Armando Quintanilla Villon 4 , Rafael Fontella Katopodis, Leandro Santiago de Araújo, Diego Leonel Cadette Dutra, Priscila Machado Vieira Lima, Felipe Maia Galvão França, Mauricio Breternitz Jr, Lizy K. John
arxiv-2203-01479.description: Abstract Weightless Neural Networks (WNNs) are a class of machine learning model which use table lookups to perform inference. This is in contrast with Deep Neural Networks (DNNs), which use multiply-accumulate operations. State-of-the-art WNN architectures have a fraction of the implementation cost of DNNs, but still lag behind them on accuracy for common image recognition tasks.

arxiv-2210-11290.title: Probing the Manipulation of Antiferromagnetic Order in CuMnAs Films Using Neutron Diffraction
arxiv-2210-11290.creator: S. F. Poole, L. X. Barton, M. Wang, P. Manuel, D. Khalyavin, S. Langridge, K. W. Edmonds, R. P. Campion, V. Novák, P. Wadley
arxiv-2210-11290.description: Abstract We describe measurements of the uniaxial magnetic anisotropy and spin-flop rotation of the Néel vector in antiferromagnetic CuMnAs thin films using neutron diffraction. The suppression of the magnetic (100) peak under magnetic fields is observed for films as thin as 20 nm indicating that they undergo a spin-flop transition.

arxiv-2303-05584.description: Abstract We present SocialGym 2.0 , a multi-agent navigation simulator for social robot research. Our simulator models multiple autonomous agents, replicating real-world dynamics in complex environments, including doorways, hallways, intersections, and roundabouts. arxiv-2311-11197.title: Determination of Stokes vector from a single image acquisition
arxiv-2311-11197.creator: Shuji Kamegaki, Meguya Ryu, Soon Hock Ng, Vygantas Mizeikis, Sean Blamires, Saulius Juodkazis, Junko Morikawa
arxiv-2311-11197.description: Abstract Four Stokes parameters (1852) define the polarisation state of light. Measured changes of the Stokes vector of light traversing an inhomogeneous sample are linked to the local anisotropies of absorption and refraction and are harnessed over an increasing range of applications in photonics, material, and space/earth observation.

arxiv-2404-18797.title: Efficiency-Effectiveness Tradeoff of Probabilistic Structured Queries for Cross-Language Information Retrieval Conference: Proceedings of the 47th International ACM SIGIR Conference on Research and Development in Information Retrieval; July 14–18, 2024; Washington D.C., USA Proceedings of the 47th I
arxiv-2404-18797.creator: Eugene Yang, Suraj Nair, Dawn Lawrie, James Mayfield, Douglas W. Oard, Kevin Duh
arxiv-2404-18797.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Eugene Yang, Suraj Nair, Dawn Lawrie, James Mayfield, Douglas W. Oard, Kevin Duh. Probabilistic Structured Queries (PSQ) is a cross-language information retrieval (CLIR) method that uses translation probabilities statistically derived from aligned corpora. PSQ is a strong baseline for efficient CLIR using sparse indexing. It is, therefore, useful as the first stage in a cascaded neural CLIR system whose second stage is more effective but too inefficient to be used on its own to search a large text collection.

arxiv-2405-07514.description: Abstract Aims. We investigate the nature of the short-term anomaly that appears in the lensing light curve of KMT-2023-BLG-1866. The anomaly was only partly covered due to its short duration, less than a day, coupled with cloudy weather conditions and restricted nighttime duration. Methods. Considering intricacy of interpreting partially covered signals, we thoroughly explore all potential degenerate solutions.

arxiv-2507-11617.title: Competing color superconductivity and color Kondo effect in quark matter
arxiv-2507-11617.creator: Pradip Kattel, Abay Zhakenov, Natan Andrei
arxiv-2507-11617.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Pradip Kattel, Abay Zhakenov, Natan Andrei. The competition between bulk color superconductivity and the localized screening of a heavy quark impurity, analogous to the Kondo effect, leads to a rich spectrum of phenomena in dense quark matter. We investigate this competition at the edge of a superconducting quark bulk, where both the superconducting gap and the Kondo scale are dynamically generated in a tractable toy model. Utilizing the exact Bethe Ansatz method, we elucidate the resulting boundary physics.

arxiv-2509-14443.title: On the Complexity of Decoded Quantum Interferometry
arxiv-2509-14443.creator: Kunal Marwaha, Bill Fefferman, Alexandru Gheorghiu, Vojtech Havlicek
arxiv-2509-14443.description: Abstract We study the complexity of Decoded Quantum Interferometry (DQI), a recently proposed quantum algorithm for approximate optimization [ JSW+25 ] . We argue that DQI is hard to classically simulate, and that the hardness comes from locating an exponentially large hidden subset.
